existing_runtime_audit.inspection_scope: read-only Pass 1 repository audit; no runtime or public-release edits authorized
existing_runtime_audit.current_pair_flag: Each reviewed generated calibration says ratingEnabled=false, but the public Formula v3 review pipeline evaluates the configured species roster and the public projection maps date.species without a species-policy filter.
existing_runtime_audit.normal_user_risk: Those four legacy rows can therefore be serialized in the current public v3 report contract despite the product policy. This finding is separate from the five new-city exclusions.
existing_runtime_audit.pass1_action: Documented only; Pass 1 is prohibited from changing runtime configuration, public visibility, deployment, or the release manifest.
existing_runtime_audit.mandatory_later_gate: Before any integration or release involving this work, remove the four legacy runtime pairs or enforce a server-side exclusion before headline selection and serialization, then test both API payloads and every client surface for zero user-visible bluegill output.
